audience: security and compliance engineers who keep card data in a Basis Theory vault

useCases.title: Find out who changed things in the vault
useCases.text: The AI reads audit-log entries: who did what to which entity and when. It can narrow them by entity type and give you a short list of changes.

useCases.title: Find the tokens that belong to a customer
useCases.text: The AI searches token metadata, for example metadata.customer_id, and lists each token's id, type, container and fingerprint. Only metadata comes back.

useCases.title: Check token counts and API usage
useCases.text: The AI reads the tenant usage report: token counts by type and container, and monthly API call volume. You get a short summary of how the vault is used.

useCases.title: Review who has access to the account
useCases.text: The AI lists tenant members with their roles, and applications with their types and permissions. It points out who can do what.

useCases.title: Check the proxies and reactors you run
useCases.text: The AI lists proxies with their destination URL and transform configuration, and lists reactors with their configuration.
